_meta.purpose: Per-route travel flavor for the v26 narration overhaul. One entry per road segment leaving a city for the next battle city. `scene` is a key in sprites/story/backgrounds manifest `scenes`. The route interstitial shows `setOut` on departure; the city arrival bookend shows `arrive`. Mirrored by DEFAULT_ROUTE_LINES in battle.html (offline fallback).

city0to1.name: Route 1
setOut: You shoulder your pack and step past the last fence of Pallet.
The badge is still warm; the road north runs long and bright and yours.
city0to1.terrain: Low coastal grass, split-rail fences, the sea somewhere off to your left.
city0to1.sightings: A Pidgey wheels overhead. A Rattata watches from the ditch and thinks better of it.
arrive: The grass gives way to gravel, then paved street. Mining sirens carry on the wind ahead.

city1to2.name: Mineshaft Pass
setOut: The road out of the mining town runs straight into the hillside and keeps going.
Lamplight, dripping stone, the rattle of an ore cart somewhere below.
city1to2.terrain: Worked-out tunnels, timber braces, the cool breath of deep rock.
city1to2.sightings: Zubat stir in the dark. A Geodude sits so still you mistake it for the wall.
arrive: Daylight again — and the smell of coffee and hot solder. A craftsman town.

city2to3.name: Route 4
setOut: Out past the kettles and the move tutors, the trees close back in.
You walk it with new moves you have not had a chance to use yet.
city2to3.terrain: Old-growth shade, mossed logs, a path more suggestion than road.
city2to3.sightings: A Caterpie inches across the trail. Something heavier moves where you cannot see it.
arrive: Bells. Students. The path widens into a campus town that runs on lectures.

city3to4.name: Route 6
setOut: The lecture halls fall behind. The signage stops. The mud starts.
Every kind of boot has come this way — ranger, hunter, poacher.
city3to4.terrain: Trailhead scrub thickening toward true wilderness.
city3to4.sightings: Oddish duck under leaves. A Nidoran freezes, then is gone.
arrive: A gate, a warden, a sign: past here, "rare" stops being decorative.

city4to5.name: Lakeside Road
setOut: You leave the Safari gate behind and follow the water down.
The wild quiets into something landscaped, lit, and for sale.
city4to5.terrain: A still lake under neon, boardwalks, the hum of a town that never sleeps.
city4to5.sightings: Magikarp slap the shallows. A Psyduck stares at the slot-machine glow.
arrive: Slot bells and gym lights share one roof here. The last easy night before the climb.

city5to6.name: Route 9
setOut: The resort lights shrink behind you. The road tilts up toward a skyline.
The air gets thinner and the buildings get taller at the same time.
city5to6.terrain: Switchback highway shoulder, billboards, the city haze ahead.
city5to6.sightings: A Spearow rides the updraft. A Machop spots for a road crew, unbothered.
arrive: The skyline ate the route signs. Twenty-four hours of city, all of it.

city6to7.name: Highcountry Pass
setOut: You climb out of the metropolis until the streets give up and the rock takes over.
Wind that tastes like the high country. Stone gates somewhere ahead.
city6to7.terrain: Bare ridgeline, switchback ramps, scree that shifts under your boots.
city6to7.sightings: Onix grind through the cliffs below. A Skarmory cuts the wind, far up.
arrive: A town that has beaten the League, three times over. They will tell you the climb breaks people.

city7to8.name: Cathedral Approach
setOut: Past the Champion’s town the road runs underground, then up into stone arches.
Candle-smoke and cold air. Whatever waits here has waited a long time.
city7to8.terrain: A vaulted cavern road feeding into an old cathedral district.
city7to8.sightings: Golbat hang in the rafters. A Misdreavus is there, then is not.
arrive: Bells, candles, stained-glass Lugia. The last gym sits inside the cathedral.

approachToLeague.name: Victory Road
setOut: Eight badges. No ninth city. There is the road, and there is the Plateau.
Victory Road is not a metaphor. It is a real climb, and it is in front of you.
approachToLeague.terrain: The final ascent — switchbacks, sealed doors, trainers who never left.
approachToLeague.sightings: The strongest wild things in the region live up here, and they know it.
arrive: The Plateau hums under your boots. The Elite Four are in their chambers, waiting on you.
